Maria —

Thanks, and noted on the procurement ask for a firm cap. High level on options we can offer:

Option A — 12-month Dedicated Commit (recommended for predictability)
- Reserved capacity (GPU pool) sized to meet your peak QPS with a committed monthly fee.
- Includes quarterly performance review and latency tuning sessions.
- We can offer a capped per-token rate for year one tied to the commit (proposal in MAP). 

Option B — Hosted Hybrid (lower upfront, variable unit pricing)
- Lower monthly commitment; traffic burst into dedicated pool when thresholds hit.
- Good if you expect fast growth but want lower initial OPEX.

Pilot structure suggestion (6–8 weeks):
- Week 0: onboarding + infra proof-of-concept (KV cache warmup, integration tests)
- Week 1–4: performance tuning and load testing (p95 target monitoring)
- Week 5–6: business validation with live traffic slice and cost forecast
- Success criteria: p95 <= target (TBD), stable per-token cost within forecast +/-10%, and audit artifacts delivered

I’ve attached the MAP and the NDA for legal. I’ll also have our security lead send the SOC2 summary and KMS diagram by end of business Friday.

Holding 6/21 10:00 PT for procurement + legal + security. Please confirm attendees and we’ll send an agenda and a short data room link ahead of time.
